items.title: Op-ed: Dolly Parton was underestimated for decades. That became one of her greatest strengths
items.description: In a candid 2015 interview, Dolly Parton told CNBC's Tania Bryer about depression, ambition and the business decisions that defined her career.

items.title: K, C or E? Why economists can’t agree on the shape of today’s economy
items.description: Economists have long viewed the post-pandemic economy as "K"-shaped. That consensus has now evaporated.

items.title: Tech backlash reaches fever pitch as AI angst collides with social media fears
items.description: With data center concerns becoming a major election issue and Meta reaching a landmark settlement in a social media case, the tech backlash is gaining steam.

items.title: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX
items.description: OpenAI plans to end model access through Cursor on Nov. 12, citing concerns after SpaceX’s $60 billion acquisition of the coding startup.

items.title: National Park Service backs Trump’s 250-foot arch despite ‘adverse effects’ on historic sites
items.description: The park service is backing the arch, despite finding that it would adversely affect historic sightlines and other visual relationships among nearby landmarks.

items.title: Trump administration weighs Yosemite land swap for private developer’s access road
items.description: The Trump administration is considering a Yosemite land exchange that could give a developer more direct park access.

items.title: We're in the midst of an 'Imax awakening,' CEO says. How the company makes millions
items.description: Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" has movie and history buffs flocking to theaters this summer. That's been great news for Imax.

items.title: Goodyear burning rubber and cash as turnaround plan continues
items.description: The tire maker has an ongoing turnaround plan as the company tries to restructure its business, refinance and pay down years of debt.

items.title: Op-ed: Salesforce just revealed the next battleground in AI — and it's not the models
items.description: For the past year, markets have vaporized roughly $2 trillion in software value by asking the wrong question about AI.

items.title: Iran trade falls as Supreme Leader Khamenei urges less reliance on the U.S. dollar
items.description: Iran's president says sanctions are hitting imports and exports, as its supreme leader urges less reliance on the U.S. dollar.

items.title: Buffett remains active at 96, but Berkshire's shares aren't doing much
items.description: Warren Buffett will be celebrating his 96th birthday on Sunday, but Berkshire Hathaway investors aren't celebrating the stock's anemic performance.

items.title: Meta’s $18 billion settlement puts TikTok and YouTube on notice. Who's next on the firing line?
items.description: "Meta is seeking to ensure its competitors will face the same rules," one business professor told CNBC after Meta called on rivals to protect children online.

items.title: Mark Walter's insurer Delaware Life sees two banks pause sale of its products amid probes
items.description: Walter's holding company earlier in the week said "there has been no fraud" at Delaware Life and its affiliated company, Clear Spring Life and Annuity.

items.title: U.S. appeals court rules against prediction markets, sets up likely fight at Supreme Court
items.description: The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that sports-related event contracts are not swaps, contradicting a 3rd Circuit ruling from April.

items.title: Trump announces deal with Venezuela to secure more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
items.description: The U.S. struck a deal with Venezuela to get majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves, Trump said in a social media post.

items.title: Trump loses bid to transfer New York hush money case to federal court
items.description: Trump's conviction in the hush money case relates to conduct that preceded the 2016 presidential election, which led to his first term in the White House.

items.title: Bessent attacks Warren over yen intervention query, offers ‘Foreign Exchange for Dummies’ lesson
items.description: Treasury has not disclosed how much yen it bought, the execution rate or the current value of the position, despite Warren’s requests for details.

items.title: CEO of buy now, pay later giant Affirm says high gas prices are hitting U.S. shoppers
items.description: The national average price for gas is at $4.09 per gallon and was last below $3 on March 2.

items.title: 2-year Treasury yield jumps as Warsh says Fed may 'have work to do'
items.description: Investors assessed Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish message in his keynote address at Jackson Hole.

items.title: Corn and wheat prices jump to highest prices in more than three years
items.description: Corn and wheat futures have surged to their highest levels in more than three years. But the reasons for these recent rallies are notably different.
